name: Triumph Bonneville (air-cooled)
engine: 790 or 865 cc air/oil-cooled DOHC parallel twin, carbs (to 2007) or fuel injected
intro: The modern air-cooled Bonnie. Early ones have carbs, later ones are fuel injected. Some 2014-2015 bikes had an injector recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2014-2015 Bonnevilles built Feb-Aug 2014 are in recall 14V694 for the fuel injectors.

G: 2001-2007 bikes have carbs. Later ones are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match your bike.

recalls.what: Fuel injector may activate when it shouldn't.

known.title: Carbs then EFI
known.what: Early 2001-2007 bikes are carbureted. Later bikes are fuel injected.
